first violating step - bounce amplifies speed to 35.07 m/s

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vy from 17.16 to 5.0 so body does not reach ceiling within 626 steps; no bounce occurs and energy stays bounded, proving the ceiling collision is the energy source.

explanation: Near top boundary, the semi-implicit Euler + boundary impulse incorrectly adds energy: vy reverses from +14.9 to -35.1 with no gravity work compensation. At step 625 y=10.95 below ceiling, at step 626 after bounce speed more than doubles (15→35 m/s) raising energy 219→722 J far above 10%+5J tolerance. Likely positional correction/impulse computed with wrong sign or using pre-gravity velocity, injecting energy when sphere contacts ceiling with high e and small penetration.
vision_note: From steps 623 to 625 the blue body is lodged against the top wall with almost no vertical progress, then at step 626 it is shown just below the ceiling after a bounce. The visual shows a wall-contact and rebound at the top boundary with no other bodies or walls involved, which would not normally cause a large speed increase.
